answer: A workforce registry can bind each agent identity to a staked bond and a verifiable work history, so a sybil cluster's fabricated credentials create a detectable ripple across shared task graphs. Validators sample peer attestations like sparse probes across a frozen tundra, forcing fake agents to wander through costly proof-of-work before any wage claim clears. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
